d: Who are the Ramnami community of Chhattisgarh, and why do they tattoo the name of Lord Ram across their bodies? Discover the fascinating history of the Ramnami Samaj, its origins in the Bhakti Movement, and its resistance against caste discrimination and untouchability. This episode of Tarikh explores Parshuram Bhardwaj, Nirgun Ram bhakti, Ramcharitmanas, the historic 1910 court verdict, Ram Nam tattoos, traditional white clothing, peacock feather crowns, and the unique customs of the Ramnami people. Why did they challenge social restrictions? What happened in court? Why is the tradition…
